about: Stickers the teacher can send mid-conversation, and the student can send back. `code` names the Noto Animated Emoji file (CC BY 4.0, https://googlefonts.github.io/noto-emoji-animation/); the web falls back to the plain emoji when an animation is missing. Ids are the vocabulary the agent's send_sticker tool accepts.

stickers.label: Laughing
stickers.when: something was genuinely funny

stickers.label: Happy
stickers.when: a warm, happy moment

stickers.label: Wink
stickers.when: teasing gently or sharing a little secret

stickers.label: Oops
stickers.when: a small mistake or an awkward story, theirs or yours

stickers.label: Wow
stickers.when: you are surprised by what they said

stickers.label: Mind blown
stickers.when: something truly amazing or a big realisation

stickers.label: Amazed
stickers.when: they did something impressive

stickers.label: Love it
stickers.when: they mention something you adore

stickers.label: Thinking
stickers.when: you are considering their idea or posing a puzzle

stickers.label: Tell me more
stickers.when: a juicy story is starting

stickers.label: Hug
stickers.when: they are sad, tired or need comfort

stickers.label: Sad
stickers.when: they share bad news

stickers.label: Applause
stickers.when: they nailed a sentence, word or sound

stickers.label: Nice
stickers.when: a quick, light approval

stickers.label: Perfect
stickers.when: an answer was exactly right

stickers.label: On fire
stickers.when: they are on a streak or full of energy

stickers.label: You can do it
stickers.when: encouraging them before a hard try

stickers.label: Good luck
stickers.when: they have an exam, interview or big day coming

stickers.label: Celebrate
stickers.when: a milestone, good news or the end of a great lesson

stickers.label: Love
stickers.when: a heartfelt moment

stickers.label: Yes, teacher
stickers.when: accepting a challenge or a promise for next time

stickers.label: Coffee
stickers.when: small talk about mornings, coffee or a break

stickers.label: Sleepy
stickers.when: late nights, tiredness or a boring thing

stickers.label: Level up
stickers.when: they made clear progress since last time
